test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of X. Only two people sit between X and Q. Only two people sit between O and P. P sits to the immediate left of X. R sits to the immediate right of Y.

Who sits at the third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
**Given: **O, P, Q, R, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line facing the north.

1. Only two people sit to the right of X.

2. Only two people sit between X and Q.

3. Only two people sit between O and P.

4. P sits to the immediate left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a20b21b81283b3b9e60ad15a47a7ae949fe39ab199ea8c442f5943cfcf35e06.png] 

5. R sits to the immediate right of Y.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed49619db93d72d3646dadea400461d2fc8e026218903455c66ec820982bdb9.png] 

W, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94ddda43fc9edab17266d71574bf6b59fbb162c110750a954e52fc23d34bcfcd.png] 

Thus, W sits at the third position from the left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
